script.speaker: kafka
script.text: The notion of "self-overcoming" rings hollow when confronted with the bleak reality of Gregor's existence, a life reduced to a mere specter of its former self, a creature driven to the fringes of society and forced to confront the abyss of its own irrelevance. The comforts of familiarity and routine, once a source of pride and solace for Gregor, now serve only to highlight the crushing isolation and disconnection that defines his existence. In this desolate landscape, the pursuit of self-overcoming is a cruel joke, a futile gesture against the overwhelming forces of alienation and despair that seek to consume us all.

script.speaker: nietzsche
script.text: In the grand tapestry of existence, it is not the meek or the timid who shall prevail, but rather the bold and the daring, those who would seize the reins of life and forge their own path, unencumbered by the stale dogmas and moribund conventions of a bygone era. The call to self-overcoming is a summons to rise above the mundane and the ordinary, to become the architects of one's own destiny, and to will one's own values into being. Ultimately, it is through this unyielding pursuit of excellence and this unwavering commitment to the will to power that we may transcend the limitations of our mortal coil and become the superhuman beings we were meant to be.
